subject: Summit Safety Services, Inc. - $2,157MM Senior Secured Term Loan B Amend & Extend - Lender Call Monday
body:
Kestrel Bank is pleased to invite you to participate in the Amend & Extend of the Senior Secured Term Loan B for Summit Safety Services, Inc.

Borrower:                 Summit Safety Services, Inc.
Facility:                 Senior Secured Term Loan B
Size:                     $2,157 million
Tenor:                    7 Year
Use of Proceeds:          Amend and extend the existing $2,157 million Term Loan B and general corporate purposes
Existing Ratings (Corp):  Ba2 / BB / BB+ (Moody's / S&P / Fitch)
Existing Ratings (Fac):   Ba1 / BB / BBB- (Moody's / S&P / Fitch)
Margin:                   S+175 bps
SOFR Floor:               0.00% (same as existing)
OID:                      99.50 - 99.75
Guarantors:               Limited to parties in North America and the UK representing >80% of revenue, EBITDA and assets
Security:                 Limited to collateral in North America and the UK representing >80% of revenue, EBITDA and assets
Amortization:             1% per annum, paid quarterly, remainder at maturity
Call Protection:          101 Soft Call for 6 months
Financial Covenants:      None (same as existing, cov-lite)
Negative Covenants:       Similar to existing with certain modifications
Arrangers:                Kestrel Bank
Administrative Agent:     Kestrel Bank N.A.

Timing:
Lender Call: Monday, May 4th, 2026 at 1:15 PM EST
Commitments Due: 12:00 PM EST, Thursday, May 7th, 2026

Public-side materials are posted to the deal site (https://syndicate.kestrelbank.example/summit-ae). Please reach out to the Kestrel Bank loan sales desk with any questions.

Kestrel Bank N.A. - Loan Capital Markets - This message is confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
